# ShopCardHub

> Price indices for Pokémon TCG sets and Bowman 1st autos. Each index is the cost of one copy of every card in a set, set to 100 at a base month and re-marked on sold prices. Last mark: Nov 9, 2026.

Every index level is a dated read of completed sales. Where a page shows a listing price it is labelled an ask. Pages track prices; they do not tell anyone to buy or sell.

## Index levels, last mark

### ShopCardHub Pokémon TCG Aquapolis Index (AQ03)
https://www.shopcardhub.com/aquapolis-index
ShopCardHub Pokémon TCG Aquapolis Index (AQ03) stood at 374.82 on Nov 9, 2026 (100 = Oct 2021), across 186 cards on sold prices; one raw copy of each card cost about $13,598. Source: sold comps (PriceCharting ungraded) · sector model · twice-weekly re-mark. Set released Jan 15, 2003.

## Method
- Price-weighted, uncapped: the index is the cost of one copy of every card in the basket, indexed to 100 at the base month. No cap and no rebalance; membership changes go through the divisor. Details: https://www.shopcardhub.com/how-prices-work
